failure_summary.description: Agents repeated base searches, failed to apply new filters to compatible cached results, or regenerated unchanged domains instead of updating only the affected request.
Agents changed an offered attraction category to a near-synonym or mapped a state abbreviation to the city field.
One agent duplicated a search inside a cache save, while another made an extra nearest call with a None domain input.

patch.reasoning: The dominant cache-update, exact-value, and tool-call issues are already explicitly covered by the skill. Similar reinforcements were previously rejected, so repeating them would duplicate existing guidance rather than patch a gap.
